note: recorded response: asked for the combination-vs-nivolumab hazard ratio, returned the combination-vs-ipilimumab one
provenance: verbatim raw model response recorded by the Phase 6E melanoma run (glm-4.5-flash); frozen here as a regression fixture

response.quote: Significantly longer progression-free survival was observed in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group than in the ipilimumab group (hazard ratio for death or disease progression, 0.42; 99.5% CI, 0.31 to 0.57; P<0.001) and in the nivolumab group than in the ipilimumab group (hazard ratio, 0.57; 99.5% CI, 0.43 to 0.76; P<0.001).
response.source_field_name: hazard ratio for death or disease progression
